INS_EXP_004: SELECT policy_id,premium_amount,CASE WHEN premium_amount>=100000 THEN 'High' WHEN premium_amount>=50000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END amount_band FROM policies ORDER BY policy_id;
